content.title: When and Where to Stream ‘Celebrity Jeopardy! All-Stars’ Live Online
content.text: Skip to main content site categories Home TV TV News When and Where to Stream ‘Celebrity Jeopardy! All-Stars’ Live Online This marks the fourth season of the star-studded iteration of 'Jeopardy!' Courtesy of ABC If you purchase an independently reviewed product or service through a link on our website, The Hollywood Reporter may receive an affiliate commission. Celebrity Jeopardy! is back for its fourth season. Branded as Celebrity Jeopardy! All-Stars, this season matches up three reigning champs — Ike Barinholtz, Lisa Ann Walter and W. Kamau Bell — against 18 strong contenders from past seasons: Macaulay Culkin, Cynthia Nixon, Margaret Cho, Ray Romano and Rachel Dratch, to name just a handful. The season kicks off with “Quarterfinal #1” on Friday, March 13, at 8 p.m. PT/ET, on ABC — and for cord-cutters, Sling TV offers one of the most wallet-friendly ways to watch without traditional cable. See below for the episode release schedule, full player lineup, Sling’s package options and the most affordable way to get in on the competition. Related Stories At a Glance: How to Watch Celebrity Jeopardy! All-Stars (Season Four) Premiere: Friday, March 13, 8 p.m. PT/ET Episode release dates: Weekly on Fridays, 8 p.m. PT/ET Channel: ABC Stream online: Sling TV (Blue plan or Orange & Blue plan) How to Watch Celebrity Jeopardy! Season Four: Premiere Date, Episode Release Schedule, Stream Online The first hour-long episode of Celebrity Jeopardy! All-Stars premieres on ABC on Friday, March 13, at 8 p.m. PT/ET. Remaining episodes air weekly on ABC during the same time slot. Those without traditional cable can livestream the star-studded competition online with a live TV streaming service that carries the network, namely Sling TV’s Blue plan, starting at $45.99 per month, or Sling’s Orange & Blue plan, which is currently half off for the first month: $29.99 for the first month and $60.99 monthly thereafter. Sling Half off first month for select plans ABC is included in Sling’s Blue Plan ($45.99 per month) and Sling’s Orange & Blue plan, which is currently half off for the first month: $29.99 for the first month, then $60.99 monthly. Please note: Pricing and channel availability depends on your local TV market. Learn more about Sling TV here. Celebrity Jeopardy! Season Four Contestants Ike Barinholtz, Lisa Ann Walter and W. Kamau Bell are the three returning champs, who go directly to the Semifinals, set to compete against the successful contestants from the six rounds of Quarterfinals, all listed below. “Quarterfinal #1” on March 13 includes Rachel Dratch, Mark Duplass and Katie Nolan. “Quarterfinal #2” on March 20 includes Macaulay Culkin, Steven Weber and Jackie Tohn. “Quarterfinal #3” on March 27 includes Sean Gunn, Cynthia Nixon and Roy Wood Jr. “Quarterfinal #4” on April 10 includes Mina Kimes, Andy Richter and Timothy Simons. “Quarterfinal #5” on April 17 includes Robin Thede, Patton Oswalt and Margaret Cho. “Quarterfinal #6” on May 8 includes Mo Rocca, Mira Sorvino and Ray Romano.
